content: robomimic HDF5 format for LIBERO: /data/demo_N/obs/{agentview_image (T,H,W,3), robot0_eye_in_hand_image (T,H,W,3), robot0_eef_pos (T,3), robot0_eef_quat (T,4), robot0_gripper_qpos (T,2), robot0_joint_pos (T,N)}; /data/demo_N/actions (T,7) delta EEF; /data/demo_N/rewards (T,); /data/demo_N/dones (T,). Top-level attrs: env_args (JSON), problem_info (JSON). /mask/train and /mask/valid for splits. LIBERO SequenceDataset in lifelong/datasets.py consumes this format.
